newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE wheat higher, driven by sterling.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE wheat higher, driven by sterling.

text.p: LIFFE wheat ended higher after a day spent following sterling, traders said.
"It was purely moving with sterling," one trader said. And an easier sterling against the mark enabled wheat to rise.
But barley, coming under harvest pressure, ended easier.
"People would rather buy 'as available' barley, so the buyers melted away," the trader said.
Active November wheat last traded 0.25 stg higher at 82.00 stg on volume of 140 out of 407 lots.
But November barley last traded 0.45 stg lower at 77.05 stg on volume of 53 of a total 100 lots.
By late afternoon, sterling was a pfennig off session highs as dollar/mark pared gains from six year peaks.
